course.title: Construction and Project Management - I
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Suppose the field supervision cost of a high-rise residential building project in (10) Khulna city is \$ 2x with a total cost of \$ 4y. The minimum and maximum general office overhead charged to the project is 2% and 4% of total field cost respectively. Calculate the average bid price for this project in terms of x and y if the profit is nil.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
